messages:
Ana K: Quick sync — finalizing GA acceptance criteria for Adaptive Burst. Proposed gates: SLA, docs, support readiness, monitoring/alerts, pricing tiers. Need owner + commit by EOD Thu. Anyone?

Matt B: Ack. Can we define precise SLOs? I'm thinking infra SLOs + tail latency targets.

Kevin L: From SRE: propose availability 99.95% for Hosted API; p95 latency <200ms for small payloads (<512 tokens), p99 <500ms. Error budget policy: 14-day rolling window, automatic fallback to compatible smaller model when >50% of budget is consumed.

Ana K: Good start. Also add burst-mode degradation behavior: graceful fallback to queued responses with a target p95 within 2s for the queued path. Document user-visible behavior.

Matt B: Yes. Also we need capacity rules for Dedicated: SLA only applies when customer has reserved commit. For GA, we must document minimum commit sizes and expected latency tiers per GPU type.

Sylvia R: Docs checklist: quickstart migration guide, API examples for enabling burst, sample configs for batching and KV cache, rollback steps, common errors + mitigations, changelog entry. I'll own docs + 2 reviewers. @Ana K can you be one?

Liam F: From Sales: pricing must include a burst add-on and a clear overcommit penalty. Customers asked for a guaranteed burst buffer (example: 1hr/month). Need product decision on whether it's included or an extra SKU. Also need sample pricing scenarios for 3 customer archetypes to share with pilots.

Ana K: Action items — owners + deadlines. I'll publish an acceptance matrix after this thread. Draft rules below for monitoring/alerts.

```
alert: AdaptiveBurstQueueLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(burst_queue_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Burst queue p95 > 2s"
```

Kevin L: Alert looks good. For GA we also need a short runbook snippet: when this alert fires -> page oncall -> throttle new requests -> enable early-fallback path -> notify #release-burst. Add a play for scaling the dedicated pool if available.

Matt B: Engineering: finish smoke perf tests across model families by Wed. Need to verify quantized kernels and KV cache behavior under burst. Will also produce benchmark CSVs for docs.

Sylvia R: Docs: will have draft by Wed EOD. Need two SMEs to sign off (engineering + SRE). I'll drop the draft in the #docs-review channel.

Ana K: Owners/deadlines recap: Matt B - perf tests Wed; Kevin L - alert rules + runbook Thu; Sylvia - docs Wed; Liam - pricing scenarios Thu; Ana K - compile GA checklist Thu EOD. If all green, target GA next Tue.

oncall-bot: Incident: Staging CI flakiness detected for burst tests — 3 failures in last hour.

Matt B: Noted — investigating failures now, pushing a fix to the test harness. Expect patch in ~30m.

Kevin L: If failing tests block GA, we should bump to the next train. Let's prioritize stabilizing the harness and re-running smoke.

Liam F: Also, can we freeze price changes during the GA announcement window? Need legal review and sign-off.

Ana K: I'll schedule a quick legal sync and update the matrix. Thanks all — please update the acceptance matrix when you complete your items.
